name: Nairobi
industries: Regional corporate headquarters, the development sector and the Silicon Savannah tech ecosystem all hire certified delivery talent.
intro:
Nairobi wears three hats at once: East Africa's commercial capital, the global development sector's African headquarters, and Silicon Savannah — the continent's most storied tech ecosystem. Each hat hires certified project talent. Regional multinationals run their African programmes from Upper Hill and Westlands; UN agencies and NGOs specify PMP-style credentials in procurement; and the fintech scene that gave the world M-PESA hires Scrum-credentialed delivery leads. There are live online batches all year for Nairobi — pick a Saturday–Sunday weekend or a Wednesday–Thursday weekday cohort — each timed to fall within normal Nairobi working-day hours; the schedule below gives the precise local start and end for every date. You train in English with an international cohort, with invoices suited to employer or donor funding. Afterwards: exam application guidance, full-length mocks, and trainer access until you're certified.

Nairobi is East Africa's program headquarters twice over: the regional hubs of global tech and consulting firms run commercial delivery from here, while the development-sector ecosystem manages donor-funded programs with reporting discipline that rivals any corporate PMO. Both value certification as portable, auditable proof of method. The course runs live online over two consecutive days in hours that fit Kenya, shown on this page in Nairobi time. Salary structures differ sharply between the commercial and development streams — the sourced Nairobi entries in the table below let you benchmark whichever track you're on. The employer list shows that dual demand base, and regional offices can certify program staff across country teams through a single private cohort.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Nairobi?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 11:00 AM – 08:00 PM EAT in Nairobi. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Nairobi?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Nairobi. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Kenya?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in Kenya and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Nairobi sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in Kenya accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: How much does {course} training cost in Nairobi?
faq.a: The fee for the live online {course} course for Nairobi is shown at the top of this page in KES and covers the complete two-day program. What you see on this page is the entire training cost; nothing is added later.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Nairobi?
faq.a: The Sat–Sun and Wed–Thu cohorts teach the same {course} content in the same two-day format. Nairobi learners with weekday client calls usually choose the weekend batch; exact local session times are in the table above.

faq.q: Can I take the {course} exam from Nairobi?
faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Nairobi; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.q: Is {course} certification recognized by employers in Nairobi?
faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Nairobi job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Nairobi work.

faq.q: What salary can a {course}-certified professional expect in Nairobi?
faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Nairobi figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.q: How soon can I start {course} training in Nairobi?
faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Nairobi — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.q: Do you offer group pricing for {course} training for teams in Nairobi?
faq.a: Yes. Teams in Nairobi can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Nairobi delivered in?
faq.a: All live {course} sessions are delivered in English, the working language of certification exams and of most project teams in Nairobi. Trainers take questions throughout the live sessions.

faq.q: How do I enroll in the {course} course from Nairobi?
faq.a: Pick a batch from the table above and use its Enroll button — you'll get a confirmation by email. The full flow is online; nothing requires visiting an office in Nairobi.

faq.q: Where can I see the {course} exam fee for Kenya?
faq.a: The exam-cost section on this page lists the current {course} exam fee for Kenya with a link to the certifying body's official fee page, so the number you plan around is the official one.

faq.q: Why choose live online {course} training over a self-paced course in Nairobi?
faq.a: Because completion and understanding differ: live {course} sessions force the exercises, discussion and Q&A that videos skip, and Nairobi learners finish in a scheduled two days instead of an open-ended queue.
